intro: This is a wholesome, friendly little submarine exploration game (˃ᆺ˂)
Your goal is to reach the bottom! The front-mounted floodlights on your sub will light the way when it gets dark. Good luck and have fun!
entering tunnel 1: Captain! Our sub won't be able to withstand the pressure down there.
We'll have to find an upgrade before we can continue down.
entering tunnel 2: We'll have to find an upgrade before we can continue down.
debris: The way down seems to be blocked by debris.
It looks loose... A nearby disturbance, like a heavy object falling, should be enough to clear the way.
Have a look around Captain. Worst case scenario, you may have to use this sub as a battering ram.
power_down: Looks like the sub took some damage pushing those boulders - the main power has gone out. We're on backup power now.
Captain, I think we should head ba-
Ignore that. Why don't we keep descending.
view_switch_tutorial: Great! Now just click on the periscope to return to the external view.
view_switch_tutorial_2: To return to the interior view at any time, press the 'C' key.
version_1_end: This is the end of version 1 of suber. Feel free to explore and try out the sonar (space key). Can you make it back to the surface without meeting an unfortunate end?
Or, you could restart and go for the speed record. Send me your best times and I'll note them down!
Don't despair! Suber will return... with an extended map, more features, and beautiful updated graphics drawn by the one and only Aronbae!
